weaknesses.title: FREQ name:count is ambiguous when token contains colon
weaknesses.detail: SYS FREQ of field a:b yields a:b:2. Peeling count with AFTER first ':' returns b:2; NUM fails; storm scan silently skips. No last-colon split or FREQ with safe sep when name has sep.

weaknesses.title: FREQ is first-seen order not count-sorted
weaknesses.detail: No native top-N by frequency. SORTN on heat plate sorts by string of whole name:count (disk_full:4 before cpu_hot:1 lexically wrong for rank). Agents cannot get hottest-first without custom EACH rebuild.
weaknesses.repro: FREQ z y z x z y → z:3\ny:2\nx:1 first-seen not sorted by count

weaknesses.title: MAPREPLACE/UPPERALL/FREQ non-mutate named bags
weaknesses.detail: Must LET bag = LAST after each; forgetting leaves dirty plate on WRITE.
weaknesses.repro: UPPERALL bag; WRITE path bag still mixed case without LET

weaknesses.title: AFTER peels first delimiter only — no RAFTER/last-colon
weaknesses.detail: Storm count peel and multi-field tokens need last-segment extract. Agents stack SPLIT+TAIL or fragile heuristics.

weaknesses.title: GREP heat substring false friends
weaknesses.detail: top disk matches disk_full:4 and would match diskette:1. No field-prefix or token-boundary GREP on heat rows.

weaknesses.title: PRINT multi-line LAST often prints length not content under some paths
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON/plate still needed for heat inspection; agent logging of FREQ bags is awkward.
weaknesses.repro: PRINT freq LAST after FREQ multi-line

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
No FREQ threshold filter / FREQWHERE
weaknesses.detail: Storm gate requires EACH+AFTER+NUM+CMP over heat. Common ops pattern deserves host form keep rows count>=N.

workarounds: Ban ':' in alert tokens before FREQ; or use FREQ custom sep '=' if tokens lack '='
Always LET bag/heat = LAST after MAPREPLACE/UPPERALL/FREQ
Prefer COUNTLINE for single-token multiplicity; FREQ for multi-token heatmap
Normalize with MAPREPLACE+UPPERALL before heat to merge case/path variants
Use HASLINE/EQS not GREP for exact heat row checks
language_gaps: FREQ safe encoding when name contains sep; or count as separate bag
FREQ SORT BY COUNT DESC / top-N form
FREQWHERE bag thresh keep hot rows
PRINT_JSON newlines; WRITE force trailing NL

Storm calm path needs REQUIRE flag; soft FAIL+CLEAR_ERR works
Norm merge Disk_Full+disk_full → DISK_FULL:2 proves UPPERALL necessity pre-FREQ
